instruction: Recover the last tab that was closed in the web browser.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to reopen the last closed tab (theguardian.com) using Ctrl+Shift+T. Evaluator verifies all 3 major newspaper websites are present in open tabs.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_open_tabs_info getter to extract all open tab URLs via Chrome DevTools Protocol
Metric is_expected_tabs with type='url' appropriately checks if all 3 expected URLs (nytimes, washingtonpost, theguardian) are present in open tabs
Expected URLs correctly match the setup configuration: the 2 tabs that remain open plus the theguardian.com tab that should be recovered
The comparison logic uses are_lists_equal with compare_urls, which provides robust URL matching
Complete coverage: evaluator checks for all required URLs to verify tab recovery was successful
No postconfig needed since Ctrl+Shift+T tab recovery is instantaneous
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The are_lists_equal function may be order-sensitive - consider verifying it handles unordered comparison correctly when tabs may be reopened in different positions
Consider adding explicit documentation that the evaluator expects exactly 3 tabs (no more, no less) for clarity
